notes: God Siege mode. The Commander (PC/Mac/Mobile) earns money over time and sends units at the God's (VR) cube; the God defends. Commander wins by destroying every Core voxel. God wins by surviving until the timer runs out. Tuned with Tools/balance_sim.py siege.

skills.name: Divine Grip
skills.desc: Grab any unit (heavier units cost more mana) and throw it like a ragdoll.

skills.name: Bubble Ward
skills.desc: A glass bubble that blocks all voxel damage inside it.

skills.name: Spring Bloom
skills.desc: Regrows up to 60 missing outer voxels (never Core).

skills.name: Comet Drop
skills.desc: Calls down a comet. Huge area damage to units (not your cube).

skills.name: Lazy Clouds
skills.desc: All enemy units move and attack at 40% speed.

units.name: Smiley Scrapper
units.desc: Cheap swarmer that chips the crust.

units.name: Wink Bomber
units.desc: Runs at the cube and pops. Throw it back at its friends.

units.name: Block Brute
units.desc: Tanky smasher. Costs triple mana to grab.

units.name: Cannon Cart
units.desc: Lobs explosive shells from long range.

units.name: Mega Buddy
units.desc: Boss. Can only be grabbed below 30% HP.
